senses.en: a polite title used before a man's last name or full name

ex.en: Mr Wang teaches us how to draw cute animals on Friday morning.
ex.zh: 王先生星期五上午教我们画可爱的小动物。

ex.en: Our science teacher Mr Li shows the class how plants grow in spring.
ex.zh: 我们的科学老师李先生向全班展示植物在春天如何生长。

tip: Mr首字母必须大写，且只能放在男子姓氏或全名前，不能单独使用。

senses.en: a road, path, or route used to get from one place to another

ex.en: Excuse me, can you show me the way to the city library?
ex.zh: 打扰一下，你能告诉我到城市图书馆的路吗？

ex.en: On our school trip, the guide knows the safest way through the green hills.
ex.zh: 在学校郊游时，向导知道穿过青山最安全的路线。

tip: 问去某地的路常用the way to + 地点，注意介词用to。

ex.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
ex.zh: 过马路前要向两边看。

ex.en: Investment in road maintenance can improve public safety and reduce transport costs for local businesses.
ex.zh: 投资道路养护能提高公共安全水平，并降低当地企业的运输成本。

col: the road to recovery｜康复之路
tip: on the road常指在旅途中；road to可比喻通往某结果的途径。

ex.en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
ex.zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。

ex.en: Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 政府应该投资于价格实惠的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

col: should be able to｜应该能够
tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；should have done常指本该做却未做。

ex.en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
ex.zh: 这是我第一次到海边来。

ex.en: Governments should first improve public transport before encouraging residents to give up private cars.
ex.zh: 政府应先改善公共交通，再鼓励居民放弃私家车。

tip: at first指起初；first可用于列举第一点。

ex.en: I carry my shopping bag in my left hand.
ex.zh: 我用左手提购物袋。

ex.en: Drivers should check their mirrors carefully before turning left, especially where cyclists share the road.
ex.zh: 驾驶员左转前应仔细查看后视镜，尤其是在与骑行者共用道路的地方。

tip: 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词；表剩余时置于名词后。

ex.en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
ex.zh: 我们的汽车停在外面的树下。

ex.en: Reducing private car use could improve urban air quality and make streets safer for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 减少私家车使用可以改善城市空气质量，让街道对行人更安全。

tip: by car不加冠词；in a car需要冠词。

senses.en: the side or direction that is opposite to the left

ex.en: Our new classroom is on the right when you go upstairs.
ex.zh: 你上楼后，我们的新教室就在右边。

ex.en: Walk past the red gate and look to the right to see the museum.
ex.zh: 走过红门后往右边看，就能看到博物馆了。

tip: “在右边”说on the right，“向右转”说turn right，注意区分。

senses.en: to ride and move forward smoothly on a skateboard

ex.en: I like to skate on my skateboard in the park after school.
ex.zh: 放学后我喜欢在公园里滑滑板。

ex.en: Many children in Shenzhen wear helmets when they skate along the smooth park path.
ex.zh: 深圳的许多孩子在平坦的公园小道上滑滑板时都会戴上头盔。

tip: skate以不发音的e结尾，加-ing时要去掉e，变成skating。

ex.en: I'm sorry I spilled juice on your clean shirt.
ex.zh: 很抱歉，我把果汁洒在了你的干净衬衫上。

ex.en: Although companies may say they are sorry for environmental damage, meaningful action is needed to restore public trust.
ex.zh: 尽管企业可能对环境破坏表示歉意，但恢复公众信任需要切实行动。

col: sorry for being late｜为迟到感到抱歉
sorry about the mistake｜为错误感到抱歉
feel sorry for someone｜同情某人
sorry to hear that｜听到那件事很难过
tip: sorry for doing表示为所做之事道歉。

ex.en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
ex.zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。

ex.en: Outdoor activities can help kids develop social skills while improving their physical health.
ex.zh: 户外活动可以帮助孩子们发展社交技能，同时改善身体健康。

tip: kid较口语；正式作文中“孩子”宜用child。

ex.en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
ex.zh: 我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。

ex.en: Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.
ex.zh: 经常熬夜的学生在上午的课堂上可能难以集中注意力并取得良好表现。

tip: late作副词指迟、晚；lately指最近，不能混用。

senses.en: an expression used to praise someone for doing something very well

ex.en: "Good job!" says Mum when I finish cleaning my messy bedroom.
ex.zh: 当我打扫完乱糟糟的卧室时，妈妈说：“做得好！”

ex.en: Our teacher smiles and says, "Good job!" after our group finishes the science poster.
ex.zh: 我们小组完成科学海报后，老师笑着说：“做得好！”

col: You did a good job!｜你做得真棒！
tip: 看到同学或朋友完成任务很棒时，可以用Good job!来表扬对方。

senses.en: an expression telling someone to move or act faster

ex.en: Hurry up! The school bus is waiting for us at the gate.
ex.zh: 快点！校车正在门口等我们呢。

ex.en: Hurry up, everyone! The morning flag-raising ceremony in our school is starting soon.
ex.zh: 大家快点！我们学校早晨的升旗仪式很快就要开始了。

tip: 催促别人动作快一点时常用Hurry up!，注意语气温和礼貌哦。

senses.en: to visit shops to look at and buy things

ex.en: On Saturday morning, I often go shopping with my mum nearby.
ex.zh: 星期六早上，我经常和妈妈去附近购物。

ex.en: Before the big holiday, many families go shopping at the supermarket for fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 在长假之前，许多家庭会去超市购物，买新鲜水果。

col: go shopping with Mum｜和妈妈去购物
tip: go + 动词-ing表示去做某项活动，shop要双写p再加ing。

senses.en: to walk outside slowly for fun or fresh air

ex.en: After dinner, my grandpa and I go for a walk outside.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我和爷爷到外面去散步。

ex.en: On sunny weekends, many families go for a walk along the green park lake.
ex.zh: 在晴朗的周末，许多家庭会沿着绿树成荫的公园湖边去散步。

col: go for a walk in the park｜去公园散步
go for a walk after dinner｜饭后去散步
tip: 这里walk是名词，前面一定要加上a，也可以说take a walk。

senses.en: to go online with a computer or phone to find information

ex.en: I use the internet to check the weather before my trip.
ex.zh: 我在出行前使用互联网查看天气。

ex.en: Students can use the internet safely at school to learn about stars and planets.
ex.zh: 学生们可以在学校安全地使用互联网，了解星星和行星的知识。

col: use the internet to learn｜用互联网学习
use the internet safely｜安全上网
tip: internet前的the读作/ði/，因为internet以元音音素开头。

senses.en: to move your body to stay healthy and strong

ex.en: We do exercise together in the morning to stay strong and happy.
ex.zh: 我们早上一起锻炼，保持强壮和快乐。

ex.en: Every day between classes, all students go outside to do exercise on the playground.
ex.zh: 每天课间，所有学生都会到操场上锻炼身体。

col: do exercise every day｜每天锻炼
tip: do exercise表示体育锻炼时，exercise一般用单数形式。

senses.en: to help clean, wash, and take care of the home

ex.en: I help my parents do housework on Sunday afternoon at home.
ex.zh: 星期天下午我在家帮父母做家务。

ex.en: Children can learn good habits when they do housework like sweeping and folding clothes.
ex.zh: 孩子们在做扫地、叠衣服等家务时能养成好习惯。

tip: housework不可数，不能加s，注意和homework（作业）区分。

senses.en: to plant, water, and take care of flowers and plants

ex.en: My grandma likes to do gardening on the sunny balcony every morning.
ex.zh: 奶奶喜欢每天早上在阳光充足的阳台上做园艺。

ex.en: In our school nature club, students do gardening together and grow green vegetables.
ex.zh: 在学校的自然社团里，同学们一起做园艺，种植绿色蔬菜。

col: love to do gardening｜喜欢做园艺
tip: garden是名词“花园”，加上-ing构成gardening表示园艺活动。

ex.en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
ex.zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
ex.zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: visit your grandparents｜探望祖父母或外祖父母
tip: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。

ex.en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
ex.zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。

ex.en: A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
ex.zh: 缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。

tip: last/next/this week前不加介词。

senses.en: to do a job or task that needs effort

ex.en: My uncle and aunt work at a big hospital near our home.
ex.zh: 我叔叔和阿姨在我们家附近的一家大医院工作。

ex.en: In group projects, students work together carefully to build a clean paper model of a bridge.
ex.zh: 在小组活动中，学生们认真合作，搭建了一个整洁的纸桥模型。

tip: 表示“在某地工作”常接介词in或at，注意or在w后发长音/ɜː/。

ex.en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
ex.zh: 我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。

ex.en: Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.
ex.zh: 更高水平的经济增长并不总能让每位公民的生活条件得到改善。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；not always是并非总是。

senses.en: a short video diary or story shared online

ex.en: Lily makes a short vlog about her cute pet cat at home.
ex.zh: 莉莉在家拍了一个关于她可爱宠物猫的短视频博客。

ex.en: Our class films a cheerful vlog to show our Spring Festival paper-cutting activity.
ex.zh: 我们班拍了一个欢快的视频博客，展示春节剪纸活动。

col: a travel vlog｜旅行视频博客
tip: vlog由video和blog合成，意思是“视频博客”，复数直接加s。

ex.en: We watched the ducks swimming across the quiet pond.
ex.zh: 我们看着鸭子游过平静的池塘。

ex.en: Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.
ex.zh: 观看教育节目的学生可能获得实用知识，但积极讨论有助于加深理解。

tip: watch 强调持续观看；see 强调看见这一结果。

senses.en: to practise slow, gentle body movements for health and balance

ex.en: My grandpa goes to the park early to do tai chi.
ex.zh: 爷爷一大早就去公园打太极拳。

ex.en: Many people in China do tai chi outdoors to keep healthy and calm.
ex.zh: 中国有很多人在户外打太极拳，以保持健康和平静。

col: do tai chi in the park｜在公园打太极拳
learn to do tai chi｜学打太极拳
tip: “打太极拳”要用动词do，不说play，记作do tai chi。

senses.en: to clean up a place and put things in order

ex.en: Please tidy up your toys before we go out to play.
ex.zh: 我们出去玩之前，请把你的玩具收拾好。

ex.en: After art class, all students help tidy up the desks, brushes, and paper.
ex.zh: 美术课后，所有同学都帮忙收拾课桌、画笔和画纸。

col: tidy up the room｜整理房间
tidy up your desk｜收拾书桌
tip: tidy up是固定短语，收拾某物可以说tidy up the room。

senses.en: a modern coastal city in southern China

ex.en: I live in Shenzhen with my family and go to school here.
ex.zh: 我和家人住在深圳，并在这里上学。

ex.en: Shenzhen is a bright, green city with lovely parks, museums, and long beaches.
ex.zh: 深圳是一座明亮、绿色的城市，有美丽的公园、博物馆和长长的海滩。

tip: 深圳是专有名词，首字母S必须大写，前面不加the。

senses.en: a large, busy city on the east coast of the United States

ex.en: My uncle lives in New York and sends us nice postcards.
ex.zh: 我叔叔住在纽约市，他常给我们寄漂亮的明信片。

ex.en: New York has tall buildings, busy streets, and a big park in the centre.
ex.zh: 纽约市有高大的建筑、繁忙的街道，市中心还有一座大公园。

col: fly to New York｜飞往纽约
tip: New York两个词的首字母都要大写，中文指纽约市。

senses.en: the name of a small, quiet countryside village

ex.en: My grandparents live in Star Village near a clean small river.
ex.zh: 我的爷爷奶奶住在一条干净小河边的星星村。

ex.en: At night in Star Village, we can see hundreds of bright stars above the hills.
ex.zh: 夜晚在星星村，我们能看到山丘上空几百颗明亮的星星。

col: go to Star Village｜去星星村
tip: Star Village是村名，属于专有名词，两个词首字母都要大写。

senses.en: a clean island city and country in Southeast Asia

ex.en: My aunt works in Singapore and takes photos of green gardens.
ex.zh: 我阿姨在新加坡市工作，拍了很多绿色花园的照片。

ex.en: Singapore is famous as a garden city with warm weather and green trees everywhere.
ex.zh: 新加坡市以花园城市闻名，天气温暖，到处都是绿树。

tip: Singapore既是国家也是城市名，首字母要大写，前面不加the。

senses.en: the name of a farm with green fields and friendly animals

ex.en: We go to Green Farm to feed cute rabbits and sheep.
ex.zh: 我们去绿色农场喂可爱的兔子和绵羊。

ex.en: On our autumn school trip to Green Farm, we pick fresh apples and feed cows.
ex.zh: 秋天学校组织去绿色农场研学时，我们摘新鲜苹果并喂奶牛。

col: visit Green Farm｜参观绿色农场
tip: Green Farm是农场名称，两个词首字母都要大写，前面不加the。

senses.en: a traditional Chinese festival on the ninth day of the ninth lunar month

ex.en: On the Double Ninth Festival, we visit our grandparents with gifts.
ex.zh: 在重阳节这一天，我们带着礼物去看望爷爷奶奶。

ex.en: Families often climb high hills together and show care for elders on the Double Ninth Festival.
ex.zh: 在重阳节，家人们常常一起登高，并向长辈表达关爱。

col: on the Double Ninth Festival｜在重阳节
celebrate the Double Ninth Festival｜庆祝重阳节
tip: 重阳节前要加the，且Double、Ninth、Festival首字母都大写。

ex.en: Our swimming lessons begin in January this year.
ex.zh: 我们今年的游泳课从一月开始。

ex.en: Many people set health goals in January, but maintaining new habits requires consistent support.
ex.zh: 许多人在一月设定健康目标，但保持新习惯需要持续的支持。

tip: 月份首字母大写；在一月用in January。

ex.en: My sister starts her new job in February.
ex.zh: 我姐姐二月份开始新工作。

ex.en: The community centre will introduce additional evening classes in February to meet growing demand.
ex.zh: 社区中心将在二月份增设夜间课程，以满足不断增长的需求。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: the third month of the year, between February and April

ex.en: Spring comes in March, and the weather gets warm in Shenzhen.
ex.zh: 春天在三月到来，深圳的天气变得暖和了。

ex.en: Every year in March, students plant young green trees on the hill near school.
ex.zh: 每年三月，同学们都会在学校附近的小山上种下小绿树。

tip: 月份March首字母要大写，表示“在三月”用in March，缩写为Mar.。

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
ex.zh: 我们将在四月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.
ex.zh: 社区菜园将于四月开放，让当地居民有更多机会自己种菜。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: the fifth month of the year, between April and June

ex.en: My birthday is in May, and we eat a fruit cake.
ex.zh: 我的生日在五月，我们会吃一个水果蛋糕。

ex.en: In May, bright flowers bloom in the park and days feel warm and sunny.
ex.zh: 五月时，公园里开满鲜艳的花朵，白天感觉温暖又晴朗。

tip: 五月May只有三个字母，没有缩写形式，且首字母必须大写！

ex.en: My sister is getting married in June this year.
ex.zh: 我姐姐今年六月要结婚了。

ex.en: The community centre will open in June, providing local residents with affordable exercise classes.
ex.zh: 社区中心将于六月开放，为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身课程。

col: by the end of June｜到六月底为止
tip: 月份首字母大写；在六月用in June。

ex.en: We usually visit our cousins for a week in July.
ex.zh: 我们通常在七月去表亲家住一周。

ex.en: In many northern countries, tourism peaks in July, creating seasonal jobs but increasing pressure on local services.
ex.zh: 在许多北方国家，旅游业在七月达到高峰，创造了季节性岗位，却也增加了当地公共服务的压力。

col: by the end of July｜到七月底之前
tip: 月份首字母大写；表示在七月用in July。

ex.en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
ex.zh: 我们通常八月去看望住在海边的祖父母。

ex.en: Tourist destinations often experience increased demand in August, putting pressure on local transport and accommodation.
ex.zh: 旅游目的地的需求往往在八月增加，给当地交通和住宿带来压力。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

ex.en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
ex.zh: 我们今年的摄影夜课九月开课。

ex.en: In many countries, the academic year begins in September, creating seasonal demand for student accommodation near universities.
ex.zh: 许多国家的学年在九月开始，使大学附近的学生住宿出现季节性需求。

tip: 月份首字母大写；用 in September，但 next September 前不加 in。

ex.en: Our local swimming pool will open again in October.
ex.zh: 我们当地的游泳池将在十月重新开放。

ex.en: The university begins its annual community research programme in October, giving students opportunities to investigate local environmental issues.
ex.zh: 这所大学每年十月启动社区研究项目，让学生有机会调查当地环境问题。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
ex.zh: 我们将在十一月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The university plans to launch its new scholarship programme in November, allowing more international students to apply.
ex.zh: 该大学计划在十一月推出新的奖学金项目，让更多国际学生能够申请。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

ex.en: My cousin is coming to stay with us in December.
ex.zh: 我表亲十二月要来我们家住。

ex.en: In many northern countries, energy demand increases in December as households need more heating during colder weather.
ex.zh: 在许多北方国家，十二月天气更冷，家庭需要更多供暖，因此能源需求增加。

tip: 月份首字母大写；在十二月用in December。

senses.en: to wake up and leave your bed

ex.en: I get up at seven o'clock every morning on school days.
ex.zh: 在上学日，我每天早上七点起床。

ex.en: Early birds get up with the sun, and healthy children start their day early.
ex.zh: 早起的鸟儿迎着太阳起来，健康的孩子也会早早开始新的一天。

col: get up at seven｜七点起床
tip: 注意区分：wake up是“醒来”，get up才是“起床离开床”。

senses.en: to eat your morning meal

ex.en: I have breakfast with my family before I walk to school.
ex.zh: 我步行去上学前，会和家人一起吃早餐。

ex.en: Doctors tell students to have breakfast every day to get energy for morning classes.
ex.zh: 医生告诉学生们每天都要吃早餐，为上午的课程补充能量。

col: have breakfast at home｜在家吃早餐
have a healthy breakfast｜吃健康早餐
tip: 三餐前通常不加the，直接说have breakfast，有形容词时可加a。

senses.en: to travel from home to school for lessons

ex.en: My sister and I go to school by bus every morning.
ex.zh: 我和妹妹每天早上乘公交车去上学。

ex.en: From Monday to Friday, children go to school happily to learn new things together.
ex.zh: 从周一到周五，孩子们开心地去上学，一起学习新知识。

col: go to school by bus｜乘公交车上学
go to school early｜早早去上学
tip: go to school表示“去上学”，school前面不加the。

senses.en: to eat your midday meal

ex.en: We have lunch at twelve o'clock in the school dining hall.
ex.zh: 我们十二点在学校食堂吃午餐。

ex.en: After four busy morning lessons, all students wash their hands and have lunch together.
ex.zh: 上完忙碌的四节上午课后，所有学生都洗手一起吃午餐。

col: have lunch at school｜在学校吃午餐
time to have lunch｜该吃午餐了
tip: “吃午餐”说have lunch，lunch前不加a或the。

senses.en: to return to the place where you live with your family

ex.en: School is over at four, and we go home by bus.
ex.zh: 四点放学后，我们坐公交车回家。

ex.en: When the sun begins to set, the tired farmers go home to have dinner.
ex.zh: 当太阳开始落山时，劳累的农民们回家吃晚饭。

col: go home by bus｜坐公交车回家
time to go home｜该回家了
tip: home在此作副词，前面不加to，不能写成go to home。

senses.en: to eat your main evening meal

ex.en: My family likes to have dinner together at seven every evening.
ex.zh: 我们一家人喜欢每天晚上七点一起吃晚餐。

ex.en: When my parents come home from work, we sit around the table and have dinner.
ex.zh: 父母下班回家后，我们围坐在餐桌旁吃晚餐。

col: have dinner at home｜在家吃晚餐
tip: 三餐前一般不加the，记好搭配：have breakfast/lunch/dinner。

senses.en: to get into bed at night to sleep

ex.en: I brush my teeth and go to bed at nine o'clock.
ex.zh: 我九点钟刷牙，然后上床睡觉。

ex.en: Primary students should go to bed early every night so they feel fresh tomorrow.
ex.zh: 小学生每晚都应该早点睡觉，这样明天才会精神饱满。

col: go to bed at nine｜九点睡觉
tip: go to bed指“上床睡觉”，bed前不加the，不要漏掉介词to。

senses.en: happening or done every day as part of normal life

ex.en: Reading English stories is part of my happy daily life now.
ex.zh: 读英语故事现在是我快乐日常生活的一部分。

ex.en: Our science teacher asks us to keep a daily record of our sunflower's height.
ex.zh: 我们的科学老师让我们每天记录向日葵的高度。

tip: 由day变y为i再加ly构成daily，常放在名词前表示“每天的”。

ex.en: My busy schedule leaves little time for cooking during weekdays.
ex.zh: 工作日里，我繁忙的日程几乎不给做饭留下时间。

ex.en: Universities should schedule examinations carefully to give students sufficient time for revision and recovery between assessments.
ex.zh: 大学应合理安排考试，让学生在各项考核之间有足够的复习和休息时间。

tip: 英音开头通常为/ʃ/，美音为/sk/；on schedule指准时。

senses.en: used before a specific clock time or exact moment

ex.en: Our English class starts at eight thirty in the morning.
ex.zh: 我们的英语课在早上八点半开始。

ex.en: The school bell rings at twelve o'clock and students walk to the dining hall.
ex.zh: 学校铃声在十二点响起，同学们走向食堂。

tip: 表示具体几点钟或时刻用介词at，如at 7:30、at noon。

ex.en: Please meet me outside the library at three o'clock.
ex.zh: 请三点整在图书馆外面和我见面。

ex.en: Starting school at nine o'clock rather than earlier may help teenagers concentrate better during morning lessons.
ex.zh: 将上学时间定在九点而非更早，可能有助于青少年在上午上课时更专注。

tip: 只用于整点；写作o'clock，不用连字符。

senses.en: thirty minutes past a given hour

ex.en: It is half past seven, so let us eat breakfast now.
ex.zh: 现在七点半了，我们吃早饭吧。

ex.en: The nature museum opens at half past nine every morning from Tuesday to Sunday.
ex.zh: 自然博物馆每周二到周日早上九点半开门。

tip: half中的字母l不发音！“几点半”常用half past + 整点。

ex.en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。

ex.en: Many rural schools have little access to digital resources, which can widen existing educational inequalities.
ex.zh: 许多农村学校很难获得数字资源，这可能加剧现有的教育不平等。

tip: little加不可数名词表示几乎没有；a little表示有一点。

ex.en: I always drink some water after walking the dog.
ex.zh: 我遛完狗总会喝些水。

ex.en: Encouraging children to drink water instead of sugary beverages may improve their dental health over time.
ex.zh: 鼓励儿童喝水而非含糖饮料，长远来看可能改善他们的牙齿健康。

tip: 不规则变化：drink—drank—drunk。

ex.en: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们的游泳课在周四放学后开始。

ex.en: A key lesson from previous environmental policies is that effective regulation requires consistent monitoring and public support.
ex.zh: 以往环境政策带来的一条重要经验是，有效监管需要持续监测和公众支持。

tip: learn a lesson常指吸取教训，不只是学习课程。

ex.en: She drew a sleeping cat in her sketchbook.
ex.zh: 她在素描本上画了一只熟睡的猫。

ex.en: Free cultural events can draw more visitors to museums and encourage wider participation in the arts.
ex.zh: 免费文化活动可以吸引更多人参观博物馆，并鼓励公众更广泛地参与艺术活动。

tip: 过去式drew，过去分词drawn；另可指平局。

senses.en: a period of fifteen minutes, or one fourth of an hour

ex.en: It is a quarter past eight, and our lesson begins soon.
ex.zh: 现在八点一刻了，我们的课很快就要开始。

ex.en: Between classes, we have a quarter of an hour to rest and drink water.
ex.zh: 课间我们有一刻钟的时间休息和喝水。

col: a quarter past nine｜九点一刻
a quarter to ten｜九点四十五
a quarter of an hour｜一刻钟
tip: a quarter指15分钟，“几点一刻”用a quarter past + 整点。

senses.en: a polite title used before the name of an unmarried woman or female teacher

ex.en: Miss Zhang is our kind English teacher with a warm smile.
ex.zh: 张老师是我们和蔼的英语老师，总是带着温暖的微笑。

ex.en: Every morning at the school gate, we greet Miss Chen with a cheerful hello.
ex.zh: 每天早上在校门口，我们都会开心地向陈老师问好。

col: Good morning, Miss Li.｜早上好，李老师。
tip: Miss用于未婚女性或女教师姓氏前，首字母M要大写。

senses.en: to clean your teeth using a toothbrush and toothpaste

ex.en: I brush my teeth for two minutes every morning and night.
ex.zh: 我每天早晚都刷牙两分钟。

ex.en: Before going to sleep, I always brush my teeth carefully to keep them strong.
ex.zh: 睡觉前，我总是认真刷牙，让牙齿保持坚固。

col: brush my teeth every day｜每天刷牙
brush my teeth carefully｜认真刷牙
tip: 刷牙不止刷一颗，所以tooth要变成复数teeth，别写成tooths！

senses.en: to clean your face with water

ex.en: I wash my face with cool water after I get up.
ex.zh: 我起床后用凉水洗脸。

ex.en: After running outside in PE class, I wash my face and feel much better.
ex.zh: 体育课在外面跑完步后，我洗了洗脸，感觉舒服多了。

col: wash my face with water｜用水洗脸
wash my face and hands｜洗脸洗手
tip: wash my face中face用单数，别人洗脸时要把my换成his或her。

senses.en: a warm way for a parent or adult to say goodbye before children sleep

ex.en: Mum turns off the small lamp and says, "Good night, kids!"
ex.zh: 妈妈关掉小台灯，说：“晚安，孩子们！”

ex.en: After reading a short bedtime story, Dad smiles softly and says, "Good night, kids!"
ex.zh: 读完一个简短的睡前故事后，爸爸温柔地笑着说：“晚安，孩子们！”

tip: Good night!用于睡前或夜间道别，晚上见面问好要用Good evening!。

senses.en: the school subject where students learn Chinese reading and writing

ex.en: We have a Chinese lesson at nine o'clock on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 我们星期一早上九点有一节语文课。

ex.en: In Chinese class today, our teacher reads an ancient poem about spring rain.
ex.zh: 今天的语文课上，老师给我们朗读了一首描写春雨的古诗。

tip: Chinese作为学科名词首字母要大写，前面不加the。

ex.en: We used coloured blocks to practise maths after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们用彩色积木练习数学。

ex.en: Strong maths skills help students interpret financial information and make informed decisions in everyday life.
ex.zh: 扎实的数学技能有助于学生理解财务信息，并在日常生活中作出明智决定。

tip: 英式用 maths，美式用 math；作主语用单数动词。

ex.en: We practise English together while walking home from college.
ex.zh: 我们从学院步行回家时一起练习英语。

ex.en: Learning English can widen access to international research and help students communicate across cultural boundaries.
ex.zh: 学习英语可以拓宽获取国际研究成果的渠道，帮助学生跨文化交流。

tip: 首字母始终大写；English 不等于表示英国的 British。

senses.en: Physical Education, the school subject for sports and exercise

ex.en: I love PE because I can run and play football outside.
ex.zh: 我喜欢体育课，因为我可以在外面跑步和踢足球。

ex.en: During PE class on Tuesday, our teacher teaches us how to jump rope well.
ex.zh: 星期二的体育课上，老师教我们怎样把绳跳好。

tip: PE是Physical Education的缩写，两个字母都要大写。

ex.en: Soft music drifted through the kitchen while we cooked.
ex.zh: 我们做饭时，轻柔的音乐在厨房里飘荡。

ex.en: Learning music at school can develop children's creativity and provide opportunities for cooperation through group performances.
ex.zh: 在学校学习音乐可以培养儿童的创造力，并通过集体表演提供合作机会。

col: a piece of music｜一首乐曲
tip: music不可数；一首乐曲说a piece of music。

ex.en: We spent the afternoon making art with coloured paper.
ex.zh: 我们花了一下午用彩纸创作艺术作品。

ex.en: Public funding for art can enrich community life and make cultural experiences accessible to a wider audience.
ex.zh: 公共艺术资助能丰富社区生活，让更多人有机会体验文化活动。

col: a work of art｜一件艺术作品
the art of conversation｜交谈的艺术
tip: art指艺术通常不可数；一件作品用a work of art。

senses.en: Information Technology, the school subject about computers and digital skills

ex.en: We learn to type words on computers in our IT class.
ex.zh: 我们在信息技术课上学习用电脑打字。

ex.en: In IT class, students use computers safely to draw pictures and search for facts.
ex.zh: 在信息技术课上，同学们安全地使用电脑画画和查找资料。

tip: IT表示“信息技术”学科时，两个字母必须都大写，别和代词it混淆。

ex.en: We grew tiny crystals in our science class today.
ex.zh: 今天的科学课上，我们培育了微小的晶体。

ex.en: Investment in science can help countries develop cleaner energy sources and improve public health.
ex.zh: 科学投入能帮助各国开发更清洁的能源，并改善公共健康。

tip: 泛指科学通常不可数；指具体学科可用a science。

ex.en: I joined a chess club to meet new people.
ex.zh: 我加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部，想认识些新朋友。

ex.en: A school sports club can help students develop teamwork skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 学校体育社团可以帮助学生培养团队合作能力，同时鼓励他们经常锻炼。

tip: join a club表示加入社团，不用join in a club。

ex.en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
ex.zh: 一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that every student can access affordable housing and appropriate support throughout their studies.
ex.zh: 大学应确保每位学生在整个求学期间都能获得负担得起的住宿及适当支持。

tip: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

ex.en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
ex.zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。

ex.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
ex.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。

tip: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

ex.en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
ex.zh: 我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。

ex.en: Schools should give creative subjects sufficient attention because they help students develop imagination and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 学校应给予创意类学科充分重视，因为这些学科有助于培养学生的想象力和解决问题的能力。

col: subject someone to stress｜使某人承受压力
tip: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

ex.en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们班正在学习如何种蔬菜。

ex.en: Smaller class sizes may allow teachers to give more individual attention to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 较小的班级规模可能让教师给予学习有困难的学生更多个别关注。

tip: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

ex.en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
ex.zh: 一头粉色的猪正睡在木栅栏旁。

ex.en: Farmers can improve animal welfare by giving pigs enough space to move freely and explore.
ex.zh: 农民可以给猪足够的自由活动和探索空间，以改善动物福利。

tip: pig指动物；作为食物的猪肉通常用pork。

ex.en: I checked the timetable before leaving for the station.
ex.zh: 去车站前，我查看了时刻表。

ex.en: A flexible school timetable can help students balance academic subjects with physical activity and creative learning.
ex.zh: 灵活的学校课程表有助于学生兼顾文化课、体育活动和创造性学习。

col: a revised timetable｜调整后的时间表
tip: 英式常用timetable；美式常用schedule。

senses.en: to pull the country's flag up to the top of a pole

ex.en: Every Monday morning, we watch older students raise the national flag.
ex.zh: 每周一早上，我们看高年级的同学升国旗。

ex.en: Students stand straight and sing loudly when they raise the national flag at school.
ex.zh: 在学校升国旗时，同学们站得笔直并大声歌唱。

col: raise the national flag every Monday｜每周一升国旗
tip: raise表示“举起、升起”，后面直接接the national flag，不加up。

senses.en: to find the answer to a problem or puzzle by thinking

ex.en: Can you help me work out this tricky maths problem quickly?
ex.zh: 你能帮我很快算出这道有点难的数学题吗？

ex.en: Our study group talks together and tries to work out the science puzzle calmly.
ex.zh: 我们学习小组一起讨论，试着冷静地解决这道科学谜题。

col: work out a problem｜解决问题
work out the answer｜算出答案
tip: work out指通过思考算出答案或解决问题，可接problem或answer。

senses.en: at the time when school lessons end for the day

ex.en: I often play table tennis with my friend after school.
ex.zh: 放学后我经常和朋友一起打乒乓球。

ex.en: Many students join the art club or music club after school on Wednesday afternoons.
ex.zh: 每周三下午放学后，许多同学会参加美术社团或音乐社团。

col: play football after school｜放学后踢足球
go home after school｜放学回家
tip: after school表示“放学后”，中间不加the，可放句首或句尾。

senses.en: to act out a story on stage in front of others

ex.en: Our class will put on a play on Children's Day.
ex.zh: 我们班将在儿童节演出一场戏剧。

ex.en: Students in the drama club make paper hats and put on a play about animals.
ex.zh: 戏剧社的同学们制作纸帽子，演出了一部关于动物的戏剧。

col: put on a short play｜演一场短剧
put on a play at school｜在学校演戏剧
tip: 这里play是名词“戏剧”，put on是“上演”，别理解成“穿上”哦。

senses.en: a small toy or copy of a real aeroplane

ex.en: Tom builds a blue model plane with his dad on Sunday.
ex.zh: 汤姆星期天和爸爸一起做了一架蓝色的飞机模型。

ex.en: In our science club, we test how far a light paper model plane can fly.
ex.zh: 在科学社团里，我们测试一架轻便的纸飞机模型能飞多远。

col: make a model plane｜做飞机模型
fly a model plane｜放飞飞机模型
tip: model plane的复数只把后面的plane变成planes，即model planes。

ex.en: We had a great afternoon swimming in the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个愉快的下午。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet is of great importance for students living in remote areas.
ex.zh: 对于居住在偏远地区的学生来说，能够使用可靠的互联网至关重要。

tip: a great deal of后接不可数名词，表示大量。

ex.en: The firefighter showed us how to use the hose.
ex.zh: 那位消防员向我们演示了如何使用消防水带。

ex.en: Every firefighter requires regular training to respond safely and effectively to emergencies in increasingly complex urban environments.
ex.zh: 每位消防员都需要定期接受培训，以便在日益复杂的城市环境中安全、有效地应对紧急情况。

col: a trained firefighter｜训练有素的消防员
tip: firefighter不区分性别，比fireman更通用。

senses.en: a person whose job is to keep people safe and follow the law

ex.en: A friendly police officer helps our class cross the busy road.
ex.zh: 一位友善的警察帮助我们班穿过繁忙的马路。

ex.en: Every morning near our school gate, a police officer directs cars to keep children safe.
ex.zh: 每天早上在我们学校门口附近，都有一位警察指挥车辆以保护孩子安全。

col: ask a police officer｜向警察求助
tip: police officer男女警察都适用，复数是police officers。

ex.en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
ex.zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。

ex.en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
ex.zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。

tip: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。

ex.en: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
ex.zh: 我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。

ex.en: A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
ex.zh: 训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。

tip: 英语中称呼老师通常用Mr、Ms等加姓，不直接喊Teacher。

ex.en: The doctor listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
ex.zh: 我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。

ex.en: Governments should train more doctors to ensure that rural communities have reliable access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应培养更多医生，确保农村社区能够稳定获得医疗服务。

col: a doctor of philosophy｜哲学博士
tip: 看医生常说see a doctor；动词doctor可指篡改。

senses.en: a person whose job is to drive a bus safely

ex.en: The kind bus driver waits for me at the bus stop.
ex.zh: 善良的公交车司机在公交车站等我。

ex.en: Every morning, our school bus driver greets every child warmly and drives us safely.
ex.zh: 每天早上，我们的校车司机都会热情地和每个孩子打招呼并安全接送我们。

col: a bus driver｜一名公交车司机
thank the bus driver｜感谢公交车司机
tip: drive（驾驶）去e加r变成driver（司机），bus driver即公交车司机。

ex.en: We warmed our hands by the fire after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们在炉火旁暖手。

ex.en: Regular safety inspections can reduce the risk of fire in older residential buildings with outdated electrical systems.
ex.zh: 定期安全检查可以降低电气系统老化的旧住宅楼发生火灾的风险。

tip: catch fire指开始着火；be on fire指正在燃烧。

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
ex.zh: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。

ex.en: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
ex.zh: 带薪病假让员工能在家康复，并减少感染在工作场所传播。

col: call in sick｜打电话请病假
tip: 英式英语中be sick常指呕吐，feel sick常指恶心。

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
ex.zh: 社区厨房可以提供价格实惠的蔬菜汤，帮助居民在经济困难时期获得有营养的餐食。

tip: 通常不可数；点餐时two soups可指两份汤。

senses.en: a polite title used before a married woman's last name

ex.en: Mrs Green grows sweet strawberries in her small sunny garden.
ex.zh: 格林夫人在她阳光明媚的小花园里种甜草莓。

ex.en: Our neighbour Mrs Zhou always smiles and shares fresh oranges with the children nearby.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居周太太总是面带微笑，和附近的孩子们分享新鲜橙子。

col: Hello, Mrs White.｜你好，怀特太太。
tip: Mrs通常用于已婚女性姓氏前，首字母M必须大写，读作/ˈmɪsɪz/。

ex.en: My sister found a job at the local library.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在当地图书馆找到了一份工作。

ex.en: Access to practical training can help young people secure a job in a competitive labour market.
ex.zh: 获得实用技能培训能帮助年轻人在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中找到工作。

col: apply for a job｜申请工作
do a good job｜干得出色
tip: job指具体工作，可数；work泛指工作，通常不可数。

ex.en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。

ex.en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that people of all ages can travel independently.
ex.zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让各年龄段的人都能独立出行。

col: people from all walks of life｜各行各业的人
tip: 表示人们时用people；peoples指多个民族。
